theme_and_archetype.description: A serious, data-dense, industrial ingredient supplier aesthetic (e.g., Kerry, Naturex, DSM). Anchored on stark white with high-contrast text, heavy use of technical rules/dividers, and deep earth-tone accents. Avoids startup tropes, emojis, and playful animations.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-gray-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900

rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings.
Strict left-alignment for dense content and data.
Use IBM Plex Mono for technical specifications and data table values.

grid_patterns.bento_technical: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-0 border-l border-t border-gray-200
grid_patterns.items: border-r border-b border-gray-200 p-6 or p-8

spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Use border-collapse style layouts to expose the grid skeleton. No soft shadows.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#E5E7EB), sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), no shadow. On hover, slight border color darkening.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), high contrast (bg-green-800 text-white), 1px solid border. Hover states explicitly set text color.
components.tables: Dense, technical tables for product specifications. Use striped rows or 1px border. Monospace font for numerical data.
components.forms: Shadcn inputs with sharp corners. Minimal styling, focus rings use accent color (focus:ring-green-800).
components.navigation: Solid white background with a hard bottom border (border-gray-200). Sticky positioning, z-50.
components.icons: Minimal use of icons. Prefer Phosphor Icons (sharp/regular) if necessary, but prioritize real photography.

rules: No playful animations, no bouncing, no parallax.
Use subtle opacity and color transitions for hover states.
Real product photography over abstract icons.
Images should have a subtle 1px border if placed in a white background context.
Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

sections_required.name: Hero Section
sections_required.details: Company positioning: GlobServ International Traders LLP. Agricultural exporter from Tamil Nadu. Technical headline. Two CTAs (Explore Products, Request a Quote). Background should be clean white or light gray with a structured grid overlay.

sections_required.name: About / Founders
sections_required.details: Founded April 2026 by Subash Saravanan & Madan Vignesh. Focus on direct sourcing and supply chain transparency.

sections_required.name: Products Catalog & Tech Specs
sections_required.details: Detail cards for Spirulina, Aloe Vera, Vetiver (core) + Basmati, Chilli, Turmeric (optional). Each product must have a technical specification table (Moisture %, Protein %, Mesh size, Shelf life) using monospace font for data.

sections_required.name: Process (How We Work)
sections_required.details: 6 Steps: Enquiry -> Sample & Quote -> Confirmation -> Sourcing & Packing -> QC & Paperwork -> Shipping. Display as a structured, numbered grid or list. No timelines.

sections_required.name: Packaging & Export Capabilities
sections_required.details: Container specs, ports, MOQ, bag sizes. Show the cargo ship image here. Strict tabular format.

sections_required.name: Certifications & Compliance
sections_required.details: Grid of credentials: LLP, GSTIN, PAN, IEC, FSSAI, APEDA, LUT, ICEGATE. Use an exposed grid layout.

sections_required.name: Inquiry / Quote Request Form
sections_required.details: Professional B2B form. Fields: Name, Company, Email, Phone, Product Interest, Order Type, Requirements.

sections_required.name: Admin Dashboard
sections_required.details: Lightweight, functional view for managing inquiries, products, and settings.

accessibility_and_testing.testid_convention: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Focus states must have higher contrast than default.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly avoid emojis, glassmorphism, floating cards, and particles.
Implement Shadcn/UI for components but customize them to remove soft radiuses and shadows. Use sharp edges.
Use pure HTML and Tailwind for complex grid layouts (like the technical exposed grid).
Ensure the application is mobile-first responsive.
Use Phosphor icons only when absolutely necessary; prefer text or real images.
